text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer is here—an unforgettable<n>season for us
both.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That's right. That fateful event<n>happened last
summer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...What? I've been in bad health<n>because I've been
taking on too<n>much by myself?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Trainer! From here on<n>out, we do
things together!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's health improved after<n>we started
sharing responsibilities<n>and became a true team.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And we've continued to grow closer<n>ever since.
This year...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You look different somehow. Maybe<n>it's because
you've gained a bit of<n>muscle since last year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not the only reason.<n>You've got a more
resolute look in<n>your eye too...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It kind of gives me mixed feelings. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh. Like, I want things to stay<n>how they were,
but it also makes me<n>happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I don't think these changes will<n>stop. Not in you
or in me—or in our<n>relationship either.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm not afraid though. I believe we'll<n>be okay no
matter how much we<n>change.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Now then! How should we<n>spend this
summer in preparation for<n>the fall G1 races?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although we may be closer than ever,<n>some things
just never change.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I pledge to the blue skies above to<n>race through this
once-in-a-lifetime<n>summer without any regrets.
